name: kubernetes-ingress-crash-recoverable-8c08
instr:
NGINX Ingress Controller cannot reconcile related configuration artifacts atomically or recover interrupted work. Make reconciliation crash-recoverable and attributable to Kubernetes resources through activation, recovery, reporting, and observability without changing established outcomes.

Every `nginx.Manager`, including `LocalManager`, `ConfigRollbackManager`, and `FakeManager`, must issue unique string-based `TransactionID` values and exactly one committed or aborted result. Stage regular, stream, OIDC, and secret mutations together without exposing partial contents. Preserve the active configuration after abort, validation or activation failure, or interrupted staging.

Managers from `createNginxManager` or `NewPollerManager` must recover durable unfinished work deterministically before overlapping reconciliation. Route Ingress, VirtualServer, TransportServer, deletion, and mixed-resource reconciliation through one resource-attributed lifecycle. Commit every Ingress artifact before returning success. Commit VirtualServer regular and OIDC artifacts together, preserving diagnostics, ordering, weight updates, deferred effects, exclusions, reload decisions, and legacy results. Mixed-resource failure must not activate a subset.
